book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.earth.page:
Notes of Gorvan, Archmage of Stone.

Stone is patient. My tower of tuff will still stand when the castles of kings have crumbled to dust.
The stone spell tablet teaches Earthquake: the ground bursts open and hurls foes away from you. I keep it in my sanctum.
My missiles follow you, yet a bold strike sends them back. My rune shield breaks after a few blows, my mirror images after a single one.
In my rockquake I hurl boulders at you, and at the end the whole hall shakes. Keep your distance when rings of dust gather around me.

Stone spikes break from the ground in a line towards you – step aside. From my circle a fist of rock hurls you into the air.

My skin is stone: your blows hit me only weakly.

When my strength wanes, I gather life force in a circle of runes. Strike me hard and the ritual breaks – then I stagger, and your blows hit deeper.

The earth feels every footstep. Whoever shoots at me from afar is seized by a fist of stone.
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.fire.page1:
Notes of Ignatius, Archmage of Flames.

I raised this tower on black stone, far from forest and grass – fire tolerates no neighbours.
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.fire.page2: The fire spell tablet rests in my sanctum. Whoever writes it into an Aetherit staff hurls firebolts that set foes ablaze – but never one's own roof.
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.fire.page3: My missiles follow you, yet a bold strike sends them back. My rune shield breaks after a few blows, my mirror images after a single one.
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.fire.page4:
When the sky glows, I call down meteors. Watch for the rings of smoke on the ground and never stand still.

Fire does not burn me.
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.fire.page5:
My phoenixes hunt you through the hall and burst into fire where they strike. Glowing circles beneath your feet become pillars of flame – leave them!

Whoever comes too close to me catches fire.
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.fire.page6:
When my strength wanes, I gather life force in a circle of runes. Strike me hard and the ritual breaks – then I stagger, and your blows hit deeper.

And should you strike me down: the phoenix within me burns once more. From the ashes I rise again.
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.fire.title: Notes of Ignatius
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.ice.page1:
Notes of Isolde, Archmage of Frost.

In the eternal snow the air is clear and still. Here I can hear the ice grow.
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.ice.page2: The frost spell tablet teaches Frost Breath: it slows foes, freezes them solid and turns water into ice. I keep it in my sanctum.
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.ice.page3: My missiles follow you, yet a bold strike sends them back. My rune shield breaks after a few blows, my mirror images after a single one.
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.ice.page4:
When I call the blizzard, icicles fall from above. A ring on the ground shows where they strike. Keep moving, or you will freeze.

Cold does not harm me.
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.ice.page5:
I hurl fans of frost lances. Whoever lingers in my circle freezes in a prison of ice and is struck when it shatters.

A wreath of ice blades shields me – break it, it grows back.
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.ice.page6:
When my strength wanes, I gather life force in a circle of runes. Strike me hard and the ritual breaks – then I stagger, and your blows hit deeper.

When death draws near, I wrap myself in eternal ice and heal within. Shatter the cocoon quickly!
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.ice.title: Notes of Isolde
Notes of Fulgor, Archmage of Storms.

On the windy heights lightning strikes most gladly. My tower wears copper so that it listens to me.
The storm spell tablet calls lightning to any spot you aim at. At higher levels the bolt leaps from foe to foe.
My missiles follow you, yet a bold strike sends them back. My rune shield breaks after a few blows, my mirror images after a single one.

In my thunderstorm every strike is heralded by crackling sparks. Where they circle, it is about to crash.

Lightning does not hurt me.

Ball lightning circles me before it strikes. My lightning beam holds you as long as I can see you – break my line of sight.

Strike me up close and you will feel the charge.

When my strength wanes, I gather life force in a circle of runes. Strike me hard and the ritual breaks – then I stagger, and your blows hit deeper.

In the fury of the storm I call lightning down upon myself. It strengthens me – and its charge strikes all who stand too close.
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.nature.pag:
Notes of Sylvana, Archmage of the Wilds.

The trees around my tower are older than any kingdom. They whisper to me who is coming.
The wild spell tablet makes a healing bloom open: it heals you and your companions and lets plants sprout.
My missiles follow you, yet a bold strike sends them back. My rune shield breaks after a few blows, my mirror images after a single one.
In my overgrowth vinelings burst from the ground and thorns hold you fast while I heal. Strike the vinelings quickly, or they will surround you.

Thorned vines burst from my circles. My poison bloom breathes spores – and feeds me while it blossoms; stay far from it.

Leave me be for a while and I heal.

When my strength wanes, I gather life force in a circle of runes. Strike me hard and the ritual breaks – then I stagger, and your blows hit deeper.

My skin bears thorns: whoever strikes me with a blade pricks himself and is poisoned.
book.kingdomsatwar.mage_notes.water.page:
Notes of Marena, Archmage of the Tides.

On the shore I hear the sea breathe. It comes and goes – and takes what it will.
The tide spell tablet calls a wave: it pushes everything back, puts out fires and lets you breathe underwater.
My missiles follow you, yet a bold strike sends them back. My rune shield breaks after a few blows, my mirror images after a single one.
In my maelstrom the whirl drags you towards me. Fight the pull and get away before the fountain bursts up in the middle.

My tidal wave rolls through the hall and sweeps you away. Whoever stays in my circle is lifted in a bubble and gasps for air.

Arrows often glide off my shell of water.

When my strength wanes, I gather life force in a circle of runes. Strike me hard and the ritual breaks – then I stagger, and your blows hit deeper.

Crowd me, and the tide answers: a wave washes all of you away.
book.kingdomsatwar.umbrer_chronicle.page:
THE CHRONICLE OF THE UMBRER

written down by Ilvaren, seer of the Glimmer Meadows

for those who come from the light
Before the seal, the world was one. We Umbrer lived in the valleys between light and dark – until Nyxar awoke, the dragon who devours light.
Six dragons stood against him. They could not slay him, but they locked him away – and with him this whole land – behind a seal. We stayed to guard him.
For centuries we have lived in eternal twilight. We build towers of shadow stone, grow duskgrain and trade in moonsilver. The shades that stalk between the trees are Nyxar's brood.
Now the seal is broken. Nyxar sleeps in his citadel, but he will wake. Wanderer from the light: gather nightsteel and abyssite. And never look away when a shadow looks at you.

building.kingdomsatwar.barracks.descript: Fortified stone barracks or guardhouse with a watchtower, with a training yard. Every barracks lets you recruit eight more soldiers.
building.kingdomsatwar.custom.descriptio: A building you measured with the surveyor's rod.
building.kingdomsatwar.field.description: Farmland with a fence, a scarecrow and a chest – a cornfield or a kitchen garden with four beds and a tool shed. Workplace of a farmer.
building.kingdomsatwar.house.description: A home for two citizens: half-timbered house, stone cottage with a fireplace, house with a gabled porch or two-storey house with a slate hip roof.
building.kingdomsatwar.lumber_hut.descri: Log cabin or saw hut with a chopping block, logs and saplings. One bed; workplace of a lumberjack.
building.kingdomsatwar.map_house.descrip: Slender map tower or scholar's house with a lookout and telescope. One bed; workplace of a cartographer.
building.kingdomsatwar.market.descriptio: Two market stalls with striped awnings or a market hall on stone columns. Workplace of two merchants.
building.kingdomsatwar.mine.description: Pithead or winding house over a ladder shaft ten blocks deep, at the bottom the ore face. Workplace of two miners.
building.kingdomsatwar.smithy.descriptio: Workshop with forge, anvil and grindstone and the smith's chamber. One bed; workplace of a smith.
building.kingdomsatwar.storehouse.descri: Timber storehouse or fieldstone barn with chests and barrels. Here your citizens bring what they gather in the evening and the builder fetches his building materials. Costs no building materials.
building.kingdomsatwar.tavern.descriptio: Half-timbered tavern or coaching inn with a beer garden: taproom with a bar, fireplace and guest rooms. Two beds; workplace of an innkeeper.
building.kingdomsatwar.throne_hall.descr: Great limestone hall with stained glass, columns and a red carpet up to the throne. Here you are crowned.
building.kingdomsatwar.townhouse.descrip: Tall house of a wealthy family: jettied half-timbered house, stone house with a stepped gable or merchant's house with a shop. Four beds.
building.kingdomsatwar.well.description: Stone well with a tiled roof or a draw well with a winch on a paved square – the heart of every hamlet.

chronicle.kingdomsatwar.chronicle.text:
This chronicle was written by the keepers of the seal, generation after generation. It tells of a circle of six monoliths not far from the heart of the world: the Seal Circle. It was there that the seal was once forged.

Seek out the circle. The pages themselves will show you the way.

chronicle.kingdomsatwar.circle.here: You are standing in the Seal Circle.
chronicle.kingdomsatwar.circle.unknown: Only in the Overworld can the chronicle show you the way to the Seal Circle.
chronicle.kingdomsatwar.crown.text:
The land has seen a hero who defeated dragons and passed through the gate of shadows. Only one thing remains: the crown.

Return home to your kingdom. Your people are waiting for you.

chronicle.kingdomsatwar.dragon.inserted: Defeated – its shard rests in the monolith.
chronicle.kingdomsatwar.dragons.text:
At the Seal Circle, a monolith awaits the shard of each dragon. The dragons slumber in their lairs, each in its own land. None of them can be defeated alone – bring your army. The dragon compass will show you the way.

When a dragon falls, its egg and its seal shard remain. Bring the shard to its monolith.

chronicle.kingdomsatwar.kingdom.text:
You have arrived in a foreign land with little more than the clothes on your back. Yet this land is waiting for someone to unite it.

Plant a town banner to found your settlement. Coins buy you a builder, farmers and craftsmen – and every army begins with the knights and mercenaries of the villages.
chronicle.kingdomsatwar.prolog.text:
When the world was young, the Shadow World broke forth from the depths. Six elemental dragons – fire, ice, lightning, nature, earth and water – stood against it and locked it away behind a seal. Ever since, each of them has carried a sixth of that seal in its heart.

But the burden changed them. Over the centuries the guardians themselves grew wild, and today they suffer no one near their lairs.
chronicle.kingdomsatwar.seal.text:
When the last shard came to rest in its monolith, the seal shattered. What the dragons kept locked away for an age now lies open: at the heart of the circle yawns the gate to the Shadow World.

No one knows what awaits you on the other side.

Moonsilver opens every door in this village.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.chapter.abyss.tip: In the Abyss – in its water, its lava, and the void between its islands.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.chapter.caves.tip: Water deep below the ground: in any cave, and with species of their own in the cave biomes. Glow bait helps.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.chapter.deep.tip: Above the deep oceans. More bites at night – and with glow bait in your other hand.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.chapter.end.tip: Cast the hook over the edge of an island: a few blocks down, the void carries it like water. The End and the Void, biome by biome.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.chapter.fae.tip: In the waters of the Fae Realm, beyond the fae portal – each of its lands has its own.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.chapter.legends.ti: Fifteen in all the worlds. Very rare, hardly to be held – Luck of the Sea draws them and widens the catch zone.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.chapter.nether.tip: The bobber floats on lava, too. Every biome of the Nether has its own fish – and they do not burn.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.chapter.rivers.tip: Rivers, lakes and ponds of the Overworld. Some fish bite everywhere – every biome has its own besides.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.chapter.sea.tip: The seas and their shores. Every ocean, every beach and both coasts have their own species.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.chapter.shadow.tip: In the still, dark waters of the Shadow World – from the Shadow Forest down to the Shadow Depths.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.eaten.none: Tastes the way it always has

fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.wisp_garfish: Found only in the bog holes of the Mist Moor. Especially keen to bite in the rain. Sharpens the eyes for the night. But beware: poisonous.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.wisp_newt: Lives in the bog holes of the Mist Moor. Unhurried on the line – a catch for calm hands. Toughens you. The stomach turns, though.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.witch_char: Found only in the pools of the dark forest. Pulls evenly, without feints. Turns you invisible. But it leaves you hungry.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.witch_herring: Found only in the pools of the dark forest. Only after dark does the hook come alive. Soaks up the first blows. But it numbs the hands.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.wolf_loach: Lives in the pools of the dark forest. Only after dark does the hook come alive. Miners and woodcutters swear by it. But it weakens the arm.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.wolf_stickleb: Lives in the pools of the dark forest. Rises on the line like a bubble. Eat it and you vanish for a while. But it numbs the hands.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.wonder_jellyf: Caught in the pools of the Glimmerwood – and nowhere else. A rare catch. Grants extra hearts. The stomach turns, though.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.woodfringe_sh: Found only in the waterways of the sparse jungle. Bites only at night. Puts strength in the arms.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.woodpecker_br: Found only in the forest streams. Only after dark does the hook come alive. Healers give it to the wounded. Briefly takes your sight.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.world_moonfis: Caught among the drifting chunks of the World Remnants – and nowhere else. Rarely seen, more rarely landed. Closes wounds.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.world_sea_cuc: Found only among the drifting chunks of the World Remnants. Rarely seen, more rarely landed. Lifts all ailments. But it leaves you hungry.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.worldseam_lio: Caught in the embers at the Seam – and nowhere else. Glows in the dark. Afterwards you clear fences in a leap.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.worldseam_med: Circles in the nothing along the Seam. Keeps pushing upward on the line. Brings luck. But it gnaws at your life.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.wraith_jellyf: At home in the black ponds of the Shadow Forest. Rises on the line like a bubble. Eat it and you vanish for a while. Briefly takes your sight.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.wraith_sea_se: At home in the black ponds of the Shadow Forest. A prize catch worth a campfire tale. Eat it and you run like the wind. Darkness follows for a moment.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.wreck_shark: Circles in the surf of the Storm Coast. Once the sun sinks, all goes quiet. Miners and woodcutters swear by it.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.yellow_clam: Dwells among the sunflower fields. Snaps shut the moment it is touched. Puts strength in the arms. But it makes you sluggish.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.yellow_eel: At home among the sunflower fields. Especially keen to bite in the rain. No ember frightens you afterwards. But it makes you sluggish.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.yellowhaze_lo: Dwells in the steaming pools of the sulfur caves. Bites only at night. Puts strength in the arms. But it weakens the arm.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.yellowstone_b: Circles in the void beneath the End midlands. A prize catch worth a campfire tale. Soaks up the first blows.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.note.zen_minnow: Lives among the canes of the bamboo jungle. Pulls evenly, without feints. Closes wounds. But it leaves you hungry.
fishing.kingdomsatwar.special.teleport_f: Carries you off like a chorus fruit
fishing.kingdomsatwar.uncaught: The book only knows more once one has been on your hook.

intro.kingdomsatwar.line1: There was a time when a darkness rose from the depths of this world and swallowed every light.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line10: But beware: what the Seal holds back is only waiting for it to break.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line2: Forests withered, rivers turned black, and the people fled before the shadows.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line3: Then six dragons rose up – born of fire, ice, lightning, nature, earth and water.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line4: Together they forged a Seal and banished the darkness deep beneath the earth.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line5: Ever since, each of them has carried a shard of that Seal in its heart.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line6: But the centuries passed, and the burden of the Seal drove them wild.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line7: They guard their nests – in ash and ice, on stormy peaks, in ancient groves, deep within the rock and at the bottom of the sea – and suffer no one to come near.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line8: Now your time has come. Found a kingdom, gather knights around you and raise an army.
intro.kingdomsatwar.line9: Defeat the six dragons and bring their shards back to the ring of stones.
intro.kingdomsatwar.title: Kingdoms at War – Intro

Asteria burns out among the stars – the Star Canopy releases you, together with her treasure.

The World-Eater swallows you – you fall into the World Maw!

profession.kingdomsatwar.builder.descrip: Builds every building of your settlement block by block from its blueprint. Needs no workshop.
profession.kingdomsatwar.cartographer.de: Draws maps to the Seal Circle and to the nests of dragons not yet defeated; sells compasses and spyglasses.
profession.kingdomsatwar.farmer.descript: Harvests ripe crops on his field, sows again right away and tends the plants; the harvest goes into the chest at the field.
profession.kingdomsatwar.innkeeper.descr: Runs the tavern: sells bread, stews, pies, ale, wine and mead – and the great feast.
profession.kingdomsatwar.lumberjack.desc: Fells wild trees around his hut, plants a sapling for each and stacks the wood in the hut's chest.
profession.kingdomsatwar.merchant.descri: Stands at the market: buys your harvest, wood and stone, sells building goods, emeralds and useful things.
profession.kingdomsatwar.miner.descripti: Climbs down the ladder of the mine and works the ore wall: coal, iron, copper, rarely gold and gems.
profession.kingdomsatwar.smith.descripti: Hammers at the anvil of the smithy and sells steel weapons and armor; buys iron, coal and gold.
raid.kingdomsatwar.gone: The war band of %s has left your lands.
raid.kingdomsatwar.hint: Defend your town banner: if nobody guards it, they plunder your storehouse.
raid.kingdomsatwar.plunder: The war band of %s plunders the storehouse of %s (%s items)!
raid.kingdomsatwar.start: A war band of %s marches on %s – %s warriors under a captain!
raid.kingdomsatwar.subtitle: %s marches with %s warriors
raid.kingdomsatwar.title: War band!
raid.kingdomsatwar.victory: The war band of %s is beaten! Its war chest (%s silver coins and more) lies in your storehouse.
realm.kingdomsatwar.alarm: Alarm! The guards of %s have spotted you!

realm.kingdomsatwar.conquer.tribute: From now on, the realm pays tribute every day into the treasury chest in the ruler's chamber.
realm.kingdomsatwar.conquer.trophy: You take the royal standard of %s as a trophy – your own banner now hangs behind the throne.
realm.kingdomsatwar.conquer.yours: This castle already belongs to you.
realm.kingdomsatwar.discover.conquered: Conquered land – your banner flies here
realm.kingdomsatwar.discover.hint: %s: The castle guards attack anyone who sets foot inside their walls. Defeat the ruler (%s) and seize the royal standard behind the throne (right-click it) to conquer the castle.
realm.kingdomsatwar.discover.leaderless: The realm mourns its fallen ruler
realm.kingdomsatwar.lord_fallen: %s has fallen – %s is without a ruler!
realm.kingdomsatwar.lord_fallen.hint: Seize the shimmering royal standard behind the throne (right-click it) to conquer the castle – once no guard is left in the throne hall.

siege.kingdomsatwar.bridge.too_high: This wall is too high for the bridge – build the tower higher with ladders

soldier.kingdomsatwar.archer.description: Shoots from afar, never at friends. Lightly armoured – keep him behind the front.
soldier.kingdomsatwar.captain.descriptio: Makes all soldiers nearby stronger and tougher and leads them into battle.
soldier.kingdomsatwar.crossbowman.descri: Slow to reload, but his bolts fly far and flat and hit hard – never at friends.
soldier.kingdomsatwar.engineer.descripti: Reloads siege weapons half again as fast and repairs them – but rather weak in melee.
soldier.kingdomsatwar.knight.description: Plate armour and shield: blocks arrows and holds the front line.
soldier.kingdomsatwar.lancer.description: Rides his own warhorse and charges through the enemy lines with his lance lowered – the faster, the harder.
soldier.kingdomsatwar.man_at_arms.descri: Plate armour from head to toe; arrows often glance off, and his mace also hits the foes beside his target.
soldier.kingdomsatwar.name: %s %s
soldier.kingdomsatwar.shieldbearer.descr: Keeps his big shield raised, bangs on it and draws the attackers of his comrades onto himself.
soldier.kingdomsatwar.spearman.descripti: Keeps foes at bay with his long spear and hits riders, horses and big beasts especially hard.
soldier.kingdomsatwar.swordsman.descript: Chain mail and sword: reliable and cheap – the backbone of any army.
spell.kingdomsatwar.aether_bolt.descript: A beam of pure magic strikes the target you aim at.
spell.kingdomsatwar.earth.description: The ground bursts open and hurls nearby enemies away.
spell.kingdomsatwar.fire.description: Hurls a ball of living flame that sets enemies ablaze – but never your castle.
spell.kingdomsatwar.fire.level3: A phoenix flies between them, and they burst into a cloud of flame
spell.kingdomsatwar.ice.description: A breath of frost slows and chills enemies and turns water to ice.
spell.kingdomsatwar.lightning.descriptio: Calls down lightning where you aim.
spell.kingdomsatwar.lightning.level3: Chain lightning: up to four enemies
spell.kingdomsatwar.nature.description: Instantly heals you and your allies nearby, keeps healing them for a while and makes plants sprout.
spell.kingdomsatwar.water.description: A wave pushes everything back, puts out fires and lets you breathe underwater.
spell.kingdomsatwar.water.level3: Water shield: you take less damage
staff.kingdomsatwar.rank_up: Your Aetherit Staff has reached level %s: %s – its spells grow stronger!
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.all_fallen: The last dragon has fallen. Six shards, six stones – the Seal is waiting for you.
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.chronicle: Now the first of the faithful follow you. Open the Chronicle: it tells of a ring of six stones where the Seal rests. That is where your true path begins.
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.crown: The Shadow World. For centuries the Umbran folk have lived here, and somewhere in the darkness, Nyxar waits. But do not forget: back home, a realm awaits its crown.
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.crowned: And so ends the Chronicle of the Seal. A kingdom, born of a single step, has found its crown. Long live the crown!
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.dragon_1: Six stones, six empty niches. Each dragon carries its shard in its heart – and not one of them will give it up willingly. The dragon compass will show you the way.
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.fallen_ear: Terragon, the Mountainbreaker, has fallen. The earth has stopped trembling.
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.fallen_fir: Pyrrhon, the Ash Lord, has fallen. His embers have died, but his shard still burns.
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.fallen_ice: Glaciara, the Frost Queen, has fallen. The eternal ice has fallen silent.
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.fallen_lig: Voltarion, the Stormbringer, has fallen. Above the peaks, the storm is passing.
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.fallen_nat: Verdantis, Guardian of the Grove, has fallen. The ancient forest has grown still.
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.fallen_wat: Thalassa, Mistress of the Deep, has fallen. The sea lies calm.
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.kingdom: Every kingdom begins with a single step. Find a piece of land, plant your banner there – and win the first who will entrust you with his sword.
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.nyxar: Nyxar, the Shadow Dragon, has fallen. The shadows recede – but they do not forget.
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.remaining_: Only one dragon still guards the Seal. Once its shard, too, rests in the circle, the Seal will break. Be ready for what waits beneath.
Two dragons remain. Whoever listens at the seal circle by night hears something knocking beneath the stones.
Half the task is done. Three dragons remain – and a whisper rises from the deep.
Four dragons remain. With every shard the Seal grows weaker – and the darkness beneath grows restless.
Five dragons still guard the Seal. Bring the shard to its stone in the circle.
story.kingdomsatwar.narration.seal: The Seal is broken. What the dragons kept locked away for so long has awoken. The gate stands open – and beyond it lies the Shadow World.
subtitles.kingdomsatwar.ambient.world_te: The world tears in the distance
subtitles.kingdomsatwar.boss.sky_ward.ma: Boss takes aim at a flyer
subtitles.kingdomsatwar.entity.shattered: The Shattered King shakes the ground
throne.kingdomsatwar.warning: A throne of starlight hovers ahead – something old is watching.
tooltip.kingdomsatwar.enchant.boost: Stronger than usual in Kingdoms at War
tooltip.kingdomsatwar.spell_tablet.use: Inscribe it into an Aetherit Staff at the Magic Table
tooltip.kingdomsatwar.staff.charge: Hold to charge: up to +50% power
totem.kingdomsatwar.creator.revive.1: You rise with all your hearts, shielded and healing
totem.kingdomsatwar.creator.revive.2: Nova of light: foes within 8 blocks are struck and thrown back
totem.kingdomsatwar.creator.revive.3: Returns to your hand until it has held three times
totem.kingdomsatwar.ember.passive.1: Fire and lava cannot burn you
totem.kingdomsatwar.ember.revive.1: You rise with 8 hearts, fire-proof and shielded
totem.kingdomsatwar.ember.revive.2: Fire nova: foes within 6 blocks burn
totem.kingdomsatwar.frost.passive.2: Whoever strikes you is slowed by frost
totem.kingdomsatwar.frost.revive.1: You rise with 8 hearts and Resistance II
totem.kingdomsatwar.frost.revive.2: Frost nova: foes within 6 blocks freeze
totem.kingdomsatwar.grove.passive.1: Heals half a heart every 5 seconds
totem.kingdomsatwar.grove.passive.2: Poison does not cling to you
totem.kingdomsatwar.grove.revive.1: You rise with 12 hearts, sated, with Regeneration III
totem.kingdomsatwar.grove.revive.2: Your animals and troops nearby are healed
totem.kingdomsatwar.shadow.passive.2: Foes notice you only from half the distance
totem.kingdomsatwar.shadow.revive.1: You rise with 8 hearts – unseen and swift
totem.kingdomsatwar.shadow.revive.2: Foes within 10 blocks lose sight of you and weaken
totem.kingdomsatwar.stone.revive.1: You rise with 10 hearts – and ten extra hearts on top
totem.kingdomsatwar.stone.revive.2: Earthshock: foes within 6 blocks are hurled upwards
totem.kingdomsatwar.storm.revive.1: You rise with 8 hearts, swift and hasty
totem.kingdomsatwar.storm.revive.2: Lightning strikes up to six foes around you
totem.kingdomsatwar.tide.passive.1: Conduit Power: breathe, see and dig under water
totem.kingdomsatwar.tide.revive.1: You rise with 8 hearts; fire goes out, the sea carries you
totem.kingdomsatwar.tide.revive.2: Tidal wave: foes within 7 blocks are swept away
totem.kingdomsatwar.void.revive.1: You rise with 8 hearts, a few steps away from danger
totem.kingdomsatwar.void.revive.2: Saves you from the void, too: back to the last solid ground
trade.kingdomsatwar.fish.from: From your inventory or your fish bag
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.armorer.1: A chain shirt stops more than you'd think. Just not a dragon.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.armorer.2: Good armour is like a good friend: you only learn its worth when it's too late to get one.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.baker.1: Fresh bread every morning, before the rooster crows. Fancy a roll?
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.baker.2: Flour everywhere – in my hair, my shoes, my bed. You get used to it.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.butcher.1: Game from the forest tastes best. Bring me venison and I'll roast it for you.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.butcher.2: A knife, a chopping block and a fire – that's my whole art.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.cartographe: Every map I draw was once a blank spot. I like blank spots.
I know where the dragons nest. If you're brave enough – or foolish enough – I'll sell you a map.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.farmer.1: Good weather, good soil – that's all wheat needs. That, and a farmer who gets up early.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.farmer.2: Bring me pumpkins or melons, I pay in honest coin.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.fisher.1: Fish bite best just at dusk. Every child knows that.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.fisher.2: Once I had something huge on the line. It nearly pulled me into the lake. Nobody believes me.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.fletcher.1: A good arrow needs straight spruce, sharp flint and goose feathers. And patience.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.fletcher.2: Ordinary arrows won't pierce dragon scales. But they'll do for everything else.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.10: Stranger, you look like you've seen a thing or two.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.11: Tell me, is it true that dragons hoard gold?
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.12: When the bell rings, everyone goes indoors. Remember that.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.13: I've heard there are towers somewhere where mages live. Creepy.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.14: You can only sleep soundly here when the guards are at their posts.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.15: New sell-swords turn up at the mercenary hall every morning. Cheap they are not.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.16: Look at the notice board by the mercenary hall – there's usually a knight waiting for work.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.2: The guards mean well, but against a dragon? I don't know.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.3: In the afternoon we all meet in the square. Why don't you join us?
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.4: My cousin made his fortune in the town. I'd rather stay here.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.5: Some nights you can hear something big flying over the roofs.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.6: Whoever trades honestly is always welcome here.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.7: Have you seen the mill? Our pride – well, the miller's pride.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.8: There used to be nothing but forest here. Our grandparents felled every tree themselves.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.generic.9: The tavern has the best mead far and wide.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.herbalist.1: There's a herb for almost everything. Not for dragonfire, sadly.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.herbalist.2: Bring me nether wart and I'll brew you something that lets you see through the night.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.innkeeper.1: A mug of ale, a warm seat by the fire and the latest tales – you'll find it all here.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.innkeeper.2: A knight was in yesterday swearing he'd seen a dragon. After his fourth mead.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.mason.1: Every stone has a face that wants to be seen. You just have to find it.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.mason.2: These walls have stood since my grandfather's day. They'll stand long after I'm gone.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.merchant.1: Goods from distant lands! If you can't find it here, it doesn't exist – or it's coming next week.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.merchant.2: Haggle? With me? Fine, but only because you have such an honest face.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.nest: They say there's a dragon's nest to the %s, not %s paces from here. The wise give it a wide berth.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.peasant.1: I help wherever I'm needed – hay today, the bakery tomorrow. There's always work.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.peasant.2: Since the dragons woke, everyone looks at the sky more often. Me too.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.rain: Not fit weather for a dog. Come, get out of the rain!
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.scribe.1: My books hold more knowledge than one person could gather in a lifetime. Some of it is even enchanted.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.scribe.2: Ink, parchment, steady hands – that's all I need. Well, and candles.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.seal: The old folk speak of a ring of stones to the %s, a good %s paces away. Something was sealed there once that had better stay asleep.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.shepherd.1: My sheep know every stone around here. And I know every sheep by name.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.shepherd.2: Wool is the best money there is – it simply grows back.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.tanner.1: Smells strong, I know. But good leather wants good work.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.tanner.2: A saddle from my workshop outlasts the horse beneath it.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.toolsmith.1: With a good pickaxe you'll reach ores others only dream of.
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.toolsmith.2: Tools need care. Oil, a whetstone, and never leave them out in the rain!
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.village: To the %s lies %s, a village much like ours – maybe %s paces. Give the folk there my regards!
villager.kingdomsatwar.rumor.weaponsmith: My steel has met wolves, bandits and a troll. The troll cost me an eye.
A blade is only as good as the hand that holds it. But a bad blade makes any hand bad.
